Usually not. Our plants ship in plastic nursery pots with drainage holes. Decorative pots are sold separately, unless the listing says "potted," in which case the plant comes in a pot.

So check the listing for the word "potted" before you order. If you'd like a decorative pot, you can add one from our pots range. Pots also have a 30-day return window from delivery if they're unused and in their original packaging.

One tip: Leafy Plus members get 10% off pots and accessories.

Is there a particular plant you're considering? I can help with other questions about it.
